instruction: Enable Chrome's standard Safe Browsing protection (not enhanced mode) to warn about dangerous sites.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled":false,"enhanced":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling standard Safe Browsing without enhanced mode. Getter checks that enabled=true and enhanced=false.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly identifies standard Safe Browsing by checking enabled=true AND enhanced=false
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares string result to expected value 'true'
